content_of_post_to_comment: One issue I have with right-libertarians is how they claim to be for individual freedom and self-ownership, but they only care about the government exercising too much power. But the government is neither always an enemy of individual liberty, nor is it the only potential enemy of individual liberty.
comment: The deeper question may be whether liberty requires a balance of power centers. A state can constrain freedom, but so can unchecked private power—so the challenge is preventing domination from any source.
